data.title: Taylor frustrated by Exeter's international absences - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Exeter City manager Matt Taylor says he is unhappy at having to play his side's League Two fixture at Bristol Rovers without his two international players. "They're two standout players and two starting players for us so we're going to have to re-jig a few things.". They have scored just two goals in that time - in a 1-1 draw at Barnet on 1 September and in a 2-1 loss at York City a week before. "It should be a blanket couple of weekends where there's no fixtures, but I'm also conscious that then if we're playing three games a week in a compacted period of time what effect that would have on the squad further down the line. data.title: Blazers open training camp after a turbulent summer. Damian Lillard provides a steadying influence - Greenwich Time
data.content: (AP) — After a summer that included cuts by the new owner, squabbles over the renovation of the team’s arena, the hiring of a new coach and the addition of Ja Morant, the Portland Trail Blazers opened training camp with more than the usual turbulence in the background. Tom Dundon became the face of the Blazers' new ownership group before the end of last season, when the team went to the playoffs for the first time in five years. Tiago Splitter, an assistant who was promoted to head coach when Chauncey Billups was arrested last fall in a federal gambling probe, bolted for the Chicago Bulls this summer. Morant, who averages 22.4 points per game, has played in just 79 games over the last three seasons because of injuries and suspensions — including a 25-game suspension after he was seen on a livestream holding a gun while he was a passenger in a car.
